description: The temporary spellings, live-measured: a table spelled TEMPORARY / TEMP / LOCAL TEMPORARY / GLOBAL TEMPORARY / VOLATILE reports kind TEMPORARY in SHOW TABLES while TRANSIENT is its own kind and a plain table is TABLE; views take the full [SECURE] [LOCAL|GLOBAL] {TEMPORARY|TEMP|VOLATILE} prefix chain with SECURE strictly BEFORE the temporary keyword, functions take {TEMPORARY|TEMP|VOLATILE} [SECURE] with the temporary keyword strictly FIRST and no LOCAL/GLOBAL, procedures take the three temporary spellings and no LOCAL; temporary views replace and refuse duplicates like permanent ones and SHOW VIEWS' text repeats the CREATE as typed. Converted 1:1 from ddl/TemporaryTableSpellingsTest + ddl/TemporaryViewAndRoutineTest (trimmed: the session-lifetime test drives a second engine to shutdown via Java APIs).

steps.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE sp_temporary (a INTEGER)
CREATE TEMP TABLE sp_temp (a INTEGER)
CREATE LOCAL TEMPORARY TABLE sp_local (a INTEGER)
CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE sp_global (a INTEGER)
CREATE VOLATILE TABLE sp_volatile (a INTEGER)
SHOW TABLES

SELECT MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_TEMPORARY', "kind", NULL)), MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_TEMP', "kind", NULL)), MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_LOCAL', "kind", NULL)), MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_GLOBAL', "kind", NULL)), MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_VOLATILE', "kind", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TRANSIENT TABLE sp_transient (a INTEGER)
SHOW TABLES
SELECT MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_TRANSIENT', "kind", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE sp_plain (a INTEGER)
SHOW TABLES
SELECT MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'SP_PLAIN', "kind", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE VOLATILE TABLE sp_rows (a INTEGER)
INSERT INTO sp_rows VALUES (1), (2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sp_rows
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW tv1 AS SELECT 1 AS n
CREATE TEMP VIEW tv2 AS SELECT 2 AS n
CREATE VOLATILE VIEW tv3 AS SELECT 3 AS n
CREATE LOCAL TEMPORARY VIEW tv4 AS SELECT 4 AS n
CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY VIEW tv5 AS SELECT 5 AS n
CREATE GLOBAL TEMP VIEW tv6 AS SELECT 6 AS n
CREATE LOCAL VOLATILE VIEW tv7 AS SELECT 7 AS n
CREATE SECURE TEMPORARY VIEW tv8 AS SELECT 8 AS n
CREATE SECURE LOCAL TEMPORARY VIEW tv9 AS SELECT 9 AS n
SELECT n FROM tv1
SELECT n FROM tv9
CREATE TEMPORARY SECURE VIEW bad1 AS SELECT 1 AS n
CREATE TEMP SECURE VIEW bad2 AS SELECT 1 AS n
CREATE TEMPORARY FUNCTION tf1() RETURNS INTEGER AS '1'
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION tf2() RETURNS INTEGER AS '2'
CREATE VOLATILE FUNCTION tf3() RETURNS INTEGER AS '3'
CREATE TEMPORARY SECURE FUNCTION tf4() RETURNS INTEGER AS '4'
CREATE TEMP SECURE FUNCTION tf5() RETURNS INTEGER AS '5'
CREATE VOLATILE SECURE FUNCTION tf6() RETURNS INTEGER AS '6'
CREATE TEMPORARY FUNCTION tf7(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x * 2'
SELECT tf1()
SELECT tf7(21)
CREATE SECURE TEMPORARY FUNCTION bad1() RETURNS INTEGER AS '1'
CREATE LOCAL TEMPORARY FUNCTION bad2() RETURNS INTEGER AS '1'
CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY FUNCTION bad3() RETURNS INTEGER AS '1'
CREATE TEMPORARY PROCEDURE tp1() RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 1; END'
CREATE TEMP PROCEDURE tp2() RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 2; END'
CREATE VOLATILE PROCEDURE tp3() RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 3; END'
CREATE LOCAL TEMPORARY PROCEDURE bad() RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 1; END'
CALL tp1()
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW rv AS SELECT 1 AS n
SELECT n FROM rv
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW rv AS SELECT 2 AS n
SELECT n FROM rv
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW IF NOT EXISTS rv AS SELECT 3 AS n
SELECT n FROM rv
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW rv AS SELECT 4 AS n
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW shown AS SELECT 1 AS n
SHOW VIEWS LIKE 'SHOWN'
SELECT CONTAINS(UPPER("text"), 'TEMPORARY') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
